        ORG #5B00,#8B00

_DB 5+14*2; 5_Speccy + 14_GS

        PUSH HL,BC,DE
        CP 5:JR NC,GS
        LD H,0,L,A,DE,TAB128:ADD HL,DE
        LD A,(HL):LD BC,#7FFD
        OUT (C),A
EXIT    POP DE,BC,HL
        OR 1:RET

GS      SUB 5:PUSH AF
        LD BC,#7FFD,A,#17
        OUT (C),A

        LD A,(GSPAGE)
        OUT (#B3),A
        LD A,1:CALL SC; STORE PAGE 2 GS

        LD HL,#C000
GS1     LD A,(HL):OUT (#B3),A
        IN A,(#BB):RLCA:JR C,$-3
        INC L:JR NZ,GS1
        INC H:JR NZ,GS1

        POP AF:LD (GSPAGE),A
        OUT (#B3),A
        LD A,2:CALL SC; GET PAGE FROM GS

        LD HL,#C000
GS2     IN A,(#BB):RLCA:JR NC,$-3
        IN A,(#B3):LD (HL),A
        INC L:JR NZ,GS2
        INC H:JR NZ,GS2

        JR EXIT

GSPAGE  DB 0
TAB128  DB #10,#11,#13,#14,#16

SC      OUT (#BB),A
WC      IN A,(#BB):RRCA:JR C,WC
        RET
